WITH major_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member
    GROUP BY link_to_major
),
shares AS (
    SELECT member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM major_counts
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(mc.member_count) AS total_members,
    AVG(mc.member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM major_counts)) AS average_share,
    AVG(mc.member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM major_counts) - av.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM major_counts mc
CROSS JOIN average_share av
WHERE mc.member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM major_counts) > av.avg_share
